issues.detail: Net-new, recovered from data. PMAST has no status attribute; 41,206 policies (6.81%) carry a lifecycle word inside the alphabetical search key instead — LAPSED, CANCELLED, VOID, NTU, DECLINED. That hides status from every query that does not string-match, and destroys the search key for exactly the policies most likely to be looked up in error.
